decisions.story_title: WPMU DEV Dashboard plugin auth bypass affects 350K sites
decisions.reason: Real vulnerability: unauthenticated auth bypass in WPMU DEV Dashboard (350K active installs) when Hub SSO enabled, leading to full site takeover and RCE. Found by Wordfence Argus, reported to vendor Aug 19. Substantive security event.
Talos Threat Source newsletter column. Opinion/analysis piece about AI guardrails, not a specific security event or vulnerability. No actionable advisory content.
Technical tutorial on PE file bloating / binary padding (MITRE T1027.001). Educational malware dev content, not a real-world security event or advisory.
Vendor blog post promoting Wordfence Argus AI capability. The real story is the WPMU DEV vuln it found (already kept). This is marketing fluff about the tool itself.
